name: Remove Add to Cart Button for WooCommerce
author: WP Artisan

sections.description:
Remove Add to Cart Button for WooCommerce lets you hide the Add to Cart button, control product prices, and turn your store into a catalog, B2B, or quote-based system—without writing any code.

Do you want to:

* Hide the Add to Cart button?
* Show prices only to logged-in users?
* Turn your store into a catalog (no checkout)?
* Let customers send enquiries instead of buying?
* Redirect products to external or affiliate links?

This plugin makes all of that simple.

With an easy-to-use interface, you can control how products behave across your store—without touching code.

What you can do with this plugin

* Remove Add to Cart button for all users or only guests  
* Show a Login / Register button instead of Add to Cart  
* Hide product prices and display custom messages  
* Create a “Login to view price” experience  
* Display fully customizable messages (supports HTML)  
* Turn your WooCommerce store into a catalog mode store  
* Control access to Cart and Checkout pages  
* Customize stock messages (Out of Stock / Backorder)

Perfect for these use cases

* B2B / Wholesale stores → show prices only to logged-in users  
* Catalog websites → disable purchasing completely  
* Membership stores → restrict buying to registered users  
* Quote-based selling → replace Add to Cart with enquiry  
* Affiliate stores → redirect users to external sites

Fully customizable messages

You can display custom messages when:

* Add to Cart is hidden  
* Price is hidden

And style them with:

* Text color  
* Background color  
* Alignment  
* Padding  
* Font size

You can even use HTML (links, buttons, etc.).

Free Features

  • Remove Add to Cart button for all users.
  • Remove Add to Cart button for guests only.
  • Show Login / Register button instead of Add to Cart.
  • Set custom login/register page URL.
  • Customize login button text.
  • Show custom message when Add to Cart is disabled (supports HTML).
  • Hide product price.
  • Show custom message when price is hidden.
  • Disable Cart and Checkout page access.
  • Redirect users from Cart/Checkout pages.
  • Customize message styles (color, alignment, padding, font size).
  • Customize Out of Stock and Backorder messages.
  • Simple and beginner-friendly interface.
  • Translation ready.

Premium Features

Upgrade to unlock powerful advanced controls:

  • All free features.
  • Apply rules based on User Roles (e.g. wholesalers, customers)
  • Apply rules based on Customer Country
  • Set rules for specific product categories
  • Exclude specific products from rules
  • Show Product Enquiry Form instead of Add to Cart
  • Replace Add to Cart with external / affiliate link
  • Control where messages appear (shop, category, product page)
  • Show Add to Cart and Price only on selected pages
  • Customize stock messages per product
  • Priority email support
sections.installation:
1. Unzip the plugin and upload the remove-add-to-cart-button-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. To change/modify plugin global settings, go to WooCommerce > Settings > Visibility Settings tab from WordPress admin area
  4. You are ready to use plugin
sections.faq:
Can I hide the Add to Cart button only for guests?

Yes. You can Remove Add to Cart for visitors (not logged-in users) and show a login button instead.

Can I create a “Login to view price” setup?

Yes. Hide product prices and display a custom message like “Login to view price”.

Can I turn my store into catalog mode?

Yes. Remove Add to Cart and checkout to create a catalog-only WooCommerce store.

Can I show an enquiry button instead of Add to Cart?

Yes (Premium). You can allow users to send enquiries instead of purchasing.

Can I apply rules by specific product categories?

Yes, but it is our premium feature. You need to upgrade to premium to get this feature.

Can I apply rules by user role or country?

Yes (Premium). You can target specific users or regions.

Can I redirect products to external or affiliate links?

Yes (Premium). Replace Add to Cart with a custom external link.
